This maize plot is small, just 0.23 hectares, but maize in our area needs fertilizer to give good yield — the soil here is tired from years of cropping. I have some schooling and I own this land, so I plan carefully. I will buy one bag of NPK and a little urea if the price is reasonable, and I will also spread some manure from the household animals since I intercrop. I cannot afford irrigation — I depend on the rains like everyone here — but I will buy improved maize seed from the agro-dealer because with fertilizer it pays back. For weeding I will use a little herbicide to save time, and my family will do most of the work, though I will hire a few hands for land preparation.
